name: Claude
source:
Leader of the rock band Angelos and [url=/c12299]Chris[/url]'s rival. He has reddish-brown hair and wears black clothing with his guitar strapped to his back. [spoiler]Depending upon how the story unfolds, Claude's appearance may be closer to that of a minor character in certain scenarios, though he still plays a key role in several endings. In Mii's scenario, one of her several "Magical Girl Mii" mini-games involve Claude.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Popotan_characters#Claude]Wikipedia[/url].]
